sources.title: Jean de Limur
sources.creator: Photographer uncredited
sources.researchNote: No photographer or agency is credited beside the image. The portrait is the earliest likeness of him gathered here: it dates from his American years, nine years before the Paris sound film on which he worked with Kaper.

media.title: Jean de Limur — portrait, Comœdia, 12 December 1924
media.description: Press portrait of the director Jean de Limur, printed in the Paris daily Comœdia on 12 December 1924, nine years before he directed the French film for which Kaper wrote.
media.altText: Newspaper portrait of Jean de Limur in a dark suit, seen in three-quarter profile with his hands clasped.
media.rightsNote: Public domain. The photograph is printed without a photographer’s or agency’s credit and is therefore treated as an anonymous work published in 1924, for which the seventy-year term of protection in France ran out at the end of 1994.
media.publicCaption: Portrait of the director Jean de Limur, published in Comœdia on 12 December 1924.
